```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(kableExtra)
library(arrow)

panel_dir <- "C:/Users/cantwi/Dropbox/Interruption Management/IM Project/Data/Source Data/Wind Farm Data/Panel"
panel    <- read_parquet(file.path(panel_dir, "kelmarsh_panel.parquet"))
episodes <- readRDS(file.path(panel_dir, "kelmarsh_episodes.rds"))
tbl <- function(df, ...) kbl(df, ...) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed", "hover"), full_width = FALSE)
```

This dictionary is generated from the current `kelmarsh_panel.parquet`, built by
`build_kelmarsh_panel.R`. Every column gets a row. Leads and lags are summarised by
pattern rather than listed one by one. **Grain:** one row per *turbine x slot*, where a
slot is `PANEL_WIDTH`, 10 minutes by default and the native SCADA interval. A *bucket*
is the concentration-metric window `BUCKET_WIDTH` (6 hours by default, T~n~), defined
per turbine. All times are UTC and mark the start of the slot or bucket.

**How it maps to the CDC-50 panel.**

```{r mapping}
tribble(
  ~concept, ~`CDC-50 base panel`, ~`Kelmarsh panel`,
  "Unit / grain", "one line, 30-s slot", "6 turbines, 10-min slot",
  "Machine-side stop", "key process parameters at zero", "power minimum <= 0 while wind >= 4 m/s",
  "Episode", "stop seconds chained (2-s gap)", "consecutive stopped 10-min slots per turbine",
  "Logbook", "shift logbook, Table A1 classes", "controller event log, Stop rows classed by code (kelmarsh_stop_classes.csv)",
  "Interruption (treatment)", "episode matched (+-30 min) to an exogenous logbook stop", "episode matched (+-20 min) to a Grid / Environment / Fault / Comm / Requested stop",
  "Stage sub-flag", "Interruption_Feeding", "Interruption_Grid (+ _Environment, _Fault, _Comm, _Requested)",
  "Excluded stops", "pit stops, RTD/PAT, drifts", "Routine: battery and brake tests, cable unwind, oil flushing",
  "Operator stops", "(not separated)", "Interruption_Manual: separate treatment (labor / recovery)",
  "Rate outcome", "Speed", "Power",
  "Quality outcomes", "Weight, Drug_Content", "Perf_Ratio (power / power-curve potential), Power_SD; Gear_Oil_Temp (component stress)",
  "Controls", "Lot_Change, Press_Temperature, Press_Humidity", "Wind_Speed (or Wind_Bin FE), Wind_Speed_SD, Ambient_Temp",
  "Fixed effects", "Date_FE, Hour_FE", "Date_FE, Hour_FE, Turbine_FE") |> tbl()
```

# Variables

```{r dictionary}
desc <- c(
  turbine = "Turbine 1-6 (panel unit; key).",
  slot = "Slot start, POSIXct UTC (key).",
  bucket = "Start of the turbine's concentration-metric bucket containing this slot (floor of BUCKET_WIDTH).",
  Date = "Calendar date of the slot (UTC).", Hour = "Hour of day 0-23 (UTC).",
  Month = "Month 1-12.", Year = "Calendar year.",
  Date_FE = "Alias of Date for fixed-effects formulas.", Hour_FE = "Alias of Hour for fixed-effects formulas.",
  Turbine_FE = "Alias of turbine for fixed-effects formulas.",
  Hub_Height = "Hub height (m): 68.5 for turbines 3 and 6, 78.5 otherwise.",
  stop_any = "Machine-side stop: 1 if power_minimum_kw <= 0 while wind_speed >= CUT_IN (4 m/s) in the slot (CDC-50: key flows at zero).",
  stop_share = "Share of the slot's 10-min rows that are machine-side stops (0/1 at the default width).",
  episode_id = "Machine-side stop episode (consecutive stopped slots of one turbine); NA when running. Joins to kelmarsh_episodes.rds.",
  Interruption = "1 if the slot is in a machine episode matched (+-20 min, sequential) to an exogenous log stop: Grid, Environment, Fault, Comm or Requested. Slot-level treatment.",
  Interruption_Grid = "Matched to a Grid stop (grid loss, voltage, frequency). Analogue of Interruption_Feeding.",
  Interruption_Environment = "Matched to an Environment stop (icing, gusts, wind direction, tower oscillation).",
  Interruption_Fault = "Matched to a Fault stop (turbine equipment / sensor / controller fault).",
  Interruption_Comm = "Matched to a Comm stop (control-system communication failure).",
  Interruption_Requested = "Matched to a Requested stop (park master / grid operator).",
  Interruption_Manual = "Matched to a Manual stop (service, remote, emergency switch). Separate treatment, NOT part of Interruption.",
  log_stop_any = "Log-only: slot overlaps any non-Routine Stop in the event log (no SCADA confirmation needed).",
  log_Interruption = "Log-only: slot overlaps an exogenous-class Stop in the event log. Robustness flag that still sees stops when SCADA is missing (grid losses).",
  Power_Min = "Minimum active power within the slot (kW); drives the machine-side stop rule.",
  Power = "Active power, slot mean (kW). Negative = self-consumption while idle.",
  Power_SD = "Within-interval SD of active power (kW), slot mean: output stability.",
  Potential = "Power-curve potential at the measured wind (kW), Greenbyte default curve.",
  Setpoint = "Turbine power setpoint (kW); below 2050 = curtailed.",
  Perf_Ratio = "Power / Potential when Potential > 5% of rated (else NA). About 1 when running to curve; the mean is about 1.08 because the default curve is conservative.",
  Wind_Speed = "Nacelle wind speed, slot mean (m/s). The dominant control for any power outcome.",
  Wind_Speed_SD = "Within-interval wind-speed SD (m/s): turbulence control.",
  Wind_Bin = "floor(Wind_Speed): 1 m/s bins, for use as FE or a flexible control.",
  Wind_Dir = "Wind direction (deg, 0 = north).",
  Ambient_Temp = "Nacelle ambient temperature (deg C).",
  Rotor_Speed = "Rotor speed (RPM).",
  Pitch_A = "Blade A pitch angle (deg); ~90 = feathered / stopped.",
  Gear_Oil_Temp = "Gearbox oil temperature (deg C).",
  Gen_Bearing_Temp = "Generator front bearing temperature (deg C).",
  Energy_kWh = "Energy exported in the slot (kWh).",
  Lost_Downtime_kWh = "Energy lost to downtime in the slot (kWh), Greenbyte allocation.",
  Availability = "Time-based IEC B.2.2 availability (0-1).",
  n_obs = "Number of 10-min SCADA rows with power in the slot (1 at the default width).",
  N_Interruptions = "Count of exogenous episode onsets in the slot's bucket (0 when untreated).",
  Avg_Interruption_Dur = "Mean duration (min) of exogenous episodes starting in the bucket; NA when none.",
  Total_Interruption_Dur = "Summed duration (min) of exogenous episodes starting in the bucket; 0 when none.",
  Concentration_Mu = "mu_b: mean of tau (onset offset / T_n) across the bucket's exogenous onsets. NA when untreated.",
  Concentration_Sigma = "sigma_b: population SD of tau; 0 for single-event buckets, NA when untreated.",
  Concentration_CV = "sigma_b / mu_b; NA when untreated or mu = 0.",
  Treated = "1 if the slot's bucket contains at least one exogenous onset.",
  Concentration_C0 = "Concentration_Mu when treated, 0 otherwise.",
  Concentration_Sigma0 = "Concentration_Sigma when treated, 0 otherwise.",
  Concentration_CV0 = "Concentration_CV when treated, 0 otherwise.")

ll <- str_detect(names(panel), "_(lead|lag)[0-9]+$")
base <- tibble(variable = names(panel)[!ll], type = map_chr(panel[!ll], ~ class(.x)[1]),
               na_pct = map_dbl(panel[!ll], ~ round(100 * mean(is.na(.x)), 1)),
               description = unname(desc[names(panel)[!ll]]))
leadlag <- tibble(variable = names(panel)[ll]) |>
  mutate(stem = str_remove(variable, "_(lead|lag)[0-9]+$"),
         dir = str_extract(variable, "lead|lag")) |>
  group_by(stem, dir) |>
  summarise(k = paste0("1..", n()), .groups = "drop") |>
  transmute(variable = paste0(stem, "_", dir, "{", k, "}"), type = "numeric", na_pct = NA_real_,
            description = paste0(stem, " ", k, " slot(s) ", if_else(dir == "lead", "ahead", "behind"),
                                 " for the same turbine (grid-aware; NA at panel edges or missing slots)."))
bind_rows(base, leadlag) |> tbl()
```

# Episodes (`kelmarsh_episodes.rds`) and log stops (`kelmarsh_log_stops.rds`)

An episode is a run of consecutive machine-side stopped slots on one turbine. Each
log Stop gets a class from `kelmarsh_stop_classes.csv`. Log stops are then matched
in time order to the earliest unmatched episode on the same turbine that starts
within +-20 min. The episode takes the class of the stop it matched.

```{r episodes}
episodes |>
  mutate(class = coalesce(class, "(unmatched)")) |>
  group_by(class) |>
  summarise(episodes = n(), median_min = median(duration_min),
            p90_min = quantile(duration_min, .9), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(desc(episodes)) |> tbl(caption = "Machine episodes by matched class")
```

```{r log-match}
log_stops <- readRDS(file.path(panel_dir, "kelmarsh_log_stops.rds"))
log_stops |>
  group_by(class) |>
  summarise(stops = n(), matched = sum(!is.na(matched_episode)),
            pct_matched = round(100 * mean(!is.na(matched_episode))), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(desc(stops)) |> tbl(caption = "Log stops by class and match rate")
```

```{r exog-codes}
episodes |> filter(!is.na(class)) |>
  count(class, log_code, log_message, sort = TRUE) |>
  slice_head(n = 25) |> tbl(caption = "Most common matched stop codes")
```

# Notes for estimation

- **Sample.** To mirror the CDC-50 RIF spec, drop slots stopped for a non-exogenous or
  unmatched reason (`!(stop_any == 1 & Interruption == 0)`) and require
  `!is.na(Wind_Speed)`. Most unmatched machine episodes are single slots just above
  cut-in (median wind 4.4 m/s), i.e. low-wind cycling rather than real stops.
- **Why log stops go unmatched.** SCADA is missing during the stop (common for grid
  losses), the wind was below cut-in (no lost output), or the stop happened inside an
  episode that had already started. `log_Interruption` is the log-only robustness flag.
- **Wind is the key control.** Use `Wind_Bin` FE or a flexible function of `Wind_Speed`.
- **Clustering.** Six turbines share the same weather, so consider clustering by Date (site-day).
